card.name: End of a list before new section
card.fires_on: The separator (a space, semicolon or line break) right after the last item of a list, table or code listing, just before a new section or sentence starts. Seen mostly in web text and reference pages.

modes.label: After keyword lists
modes.description: A semicolon or space after the last term in a run of keywords, just before a new heading or line.

modes.label: After list or table rows
modes.description: A space after the final row of a symptom list, command list or table, before the prose resumes.
